title: Handheld Gaming Console
obstacle_policy: Circular pads preserved. Rounded rectangular pads conservatively represented by axis-aligned bounding rectangles. Existing copper, vias, zones and board outline are not imported into SRJ; routing bounds are experimental.
limitations: This isolates pad escape and signal routing, not complete handheld power/ground integration.
Matching limits are provisional geometry objectives, not verified DDR timing.
Connectivity mode uses one inner carrier and 0.09mm clearance; not full multi-layer matching or new SI clearance approval.
source_ownership: User-provided handheld design; retained locally, no new hardware redistribution license asserted.
derivation: Six-layer experiment: only layerCount and global allowedLayers changed from the preserved eight-layer input; native pad geometry and constraints retained.
